title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. This sketch will consist of a loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0333, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.0333, 0.0) and ends at (0.0333, 0.0333). The third line starts at (0.0333, 0.0333) and ends at (0.0, 0.0333). The fourth line completes the loop by starting at (0.0, 0.0333) and ending at the origin (0.0, 0.0). After drawing the loop, apply a scale factor of 0.0333 to the entire sketch to ensure the correct dimensions. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector to maintain its position. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction to a depth of 0.75 meters, and create a new solid body from this extrusion. The resulting rectangular prism will have a length of 0.0333 meters, a width of 0.0333 meters, and a height of 0.75 meters.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0333, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0333, 0.0333) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0333) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a 3D object
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0333, 0).lineTo(0.0333, 0.0333).lineTo(0, 0.0333).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D object
extruded = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = extruded
